answer:
For a **complete front-left brake replacement** on your **Voltrieve Fjord AWD**, the service guide calls for these parts. The front pads are supplied as an axle set, so the set covers both front sides. The AWD front disc is 370 mm. *(Source: **voltrieve-service-guide.md**; catalog fitments and article numbers: **voltrieve-parts-brakes.md**.)*

| Qty | Part | Article number |
|---:|---|---|
| 1 | Front-left brake disc, 370 mm | **VP-10072** |
| 1 set | Front brake pads, for 370 mm disc (covers both sides) | **VP-10254** |
| 1 | Front-left brake caliper | **VP-10345** |
| 1 | Front-left caliper carrier | **VP-10527** |
| 1 | Front-left brake hose | **VP-10631** |
| 1 | Front-left pad wear sensor | **VP-10670** |
| 1 | Front-axle caliper fitting kit | **VP-10709** |
| 1 | Front-left brake dust shield | **VP-10761** |
| 1 bottle | DOT 4 LV brake fluid | **VP-15168** |

The guide includes brake fluid for bleeding the circuit after the replacement.

question: brakes-lumen
answer:
For a **complete front-left brake replacement** on your Lumen, the parts depend on whether it’s **RWD or AWD**. The service guide says the front disc, caliper, carrier and hose are replaced on the worked side, while the pad set covers both front wheels. It also specifies a fitting kit and brake fluid. **The Lumen has no electrical pad-wear sensor.** - *voltrieve-service-guide.md*

| Part | RWD | AWD |
|---|---|---|
| Front-left brake disc | **VP-10020** - 300 mm | **VP-10033** - 320 mm |
| Front pad set - covers both front sides | **VP-10202** | **VP-10215** |
| Front-left caliper | **VP-10293** | **VP-10306** |
| Front-left caliper carrier | **VP-10475** | **VP-10488** |

For **either drive**, also get:

- **VP-10618** - front-left brake hose
- **VP-10696** - front caliper fitting kit
- **VP-10735** - front-left brake dust shield
- **VP-15168** - 1-litre bottle of DOT 4 LV brake fluid

- *voltrieve-parts-brakes.md*

Check your drive configuration before ordering the drive-specific parts. The service guide specifies 300 mm front discs for RWD and 320 mm for AWD. - *voltrieve-service-guide.md*
